_comment: Govee BLE Venus OS Bridge - Configuration File
_allowlist_help: Add MAC addresses of Govee sensors to monitor (uppercase format).
To find your sensor MAC addresses, run: /data/govee-ble/find-sensors.sh
_names_help: Custom display names for each sensor (optional).
If not specified, defaults to GVH5101_XXXX (last 4 digits of MAC).
You can also change names in Venus OS GUI (Settings -> Temperature sensors).
_temperature_type_help: Temperature type override for specific sensors (optional).
You can also change types in Venus OS GUI (Settings -> Temperature sensors).
_temperature_type_default_help: Default type for sensors not in temperature_type map
_device_instances_help: Auto-calculated from MAC address, do not edit manually
_ble_interface_help: Bluetooth interface to use (hci0 is typical)
_log_level_help: Logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR
_log_path_help: Path to log file (rotates at 10MB, keeps 7 files = 70MB max)
_update_interval_sec_help: How often to process BLE advertisements (seconds)
_stale_threshold_sec_help: Mark sensor disconnected after N seconds without update
_restart_delay_help: Exponential backoff timing for service restarts after crashes
_parser_version_help: Parser version identifier, do not edit
